projects.title: Megacalc
bullets: Built a terminal-based step-by-step calculator covering PreCalc 12 topics, adding optional graphing through Plotly for visual verification.
Structured the codebase across 19 files to keep calculation logic separate from the command-line interface.

projects.title: Bitshell
bullets: Developed a browser extension converting binary, hex, decimal and text with automatic format detection and IPv4/IPv6 support.
Added a right-click context menu and conversion history so users could reuse recent lookups without retyping values.

projects.title: Skribblpro
bullets: Built a browser extension that suggests words in real time using frequency analysis learned from prior rounds played.
Iterated on the filtering logic after early guesses surfaced irrelevant words, tightening the matching criteria.

leadership.title: Peer Debugging Session Lead
bullets: Noticed classmates abandoning side projects after getting stuck alone, so started a weekly drop-in debugging session.
Began keeping a shared log of recurring issues, which shortened later sessions once patterns became easy to recognize.
